channel.title: Mix That Drink - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Mix That Drink (mixthatdrink.com)

item.title: Holiday Cheer Cocktail
item.description: Enjoy the festive Holiday Cheer cocktail made with peppermint vodka, white crème de cacao, cranberry juice, rosemary syrup, and lime juice. Cheers!

item.title: Toasted Marshmallow Martini
item.description: Indulge in a Toasted Marshmallow Martini with marshmallow vodka, toasted marshmallow syrup, and cream, garnished with toasted marshmallows and optional graham cracker rim.

item.title: Reindeer Tracks Martini
item.description: The Reindeer Tracks Martini is a decadent blend of chocolate vodka, Frangelico, and creme de cacao with a cookie crumble rim. Perfect for parties or dessert!

item.title: Chocolate Peppermint Stick Cocktail
item.description: This delicious drink blends creme de cacao with cream and peppermint schnapps. It tastes like chocolate thin mint cookies, and is perfect for holiday parties.

item.title: Belgian Brownie Drink Recipe
item.description: A creamy chocolate cocktail blending Jenever, cognac, and chocolate liqueur for a grown-up sweet nightcap.

item.title: How to Make the Classic Tom & Jerry Cocktail Recipe
item.description: A cocktail that's made with batter? Be honest. This is what you've been looking for all your life. And the soothing warm Tom & Jerry cocktail is the answer.

item.title: Mulled Wine Recipe
item.description: Mulled wine is a traditional winter alternative to fruit punch. It's a little spicier, and a little more warming to cold bodies. While it involves a lot of ingredients and a little bit of cooking, it's easy enough to make.

item.title: Candy Cane Cocktail
item.description: Enjoy a festive Candy Cane Cocktail with berry vodka, mint, and chocolate flavors. Perfect for holiday gatherings or a cozy night in.

item.title: Poinsettia Champagne Cocktail Recipe
item.description: The festive Poinsettia cocktail blends Cointreau, cranberry juice, and champagne. Perfect for holiday parties, it's refreshing, easy to make and light.

item.title: 33 New Years Cocktails That Aren’t All Champagne
item.description: Celebrate the New Year with festive cocktails and mocktails, featuring bubbly champagne, fruity flavors, and easy recipes for every celebration style.
